adjudication.rationale: In `packages/lib/CalendarService.ts` (BaseCalendarService), the CalDAV/Apple event creation now filters candidate calendars using only the first destination calendar: `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];` then `.filter(c => mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId ? c.externalId === mainHostDestinationCalendar.externalId : true)`. But elsewhere in the diff `destinationCalendar` was changed to an array and `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` iterates over each destination and calls `createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)` without reordering/mutating `event.destinationCalendar` per destination. That means when creating an event for a non-main host credential, the CalDAV/Apple service will still filter calendars by the main host externalId, likely producing no matching calendar and thus no event created for that host.
